rows_sidecar.basis: line 1 the header, then every sealed block's rows as sealed (each row's lock its block's teacher as_of); sha256 of the file's bytes, read once; nothing rebuilt or compared

blocks.rule: blocks_sha256 = sha256 of the lines "<index> <block json sha256> <sidecar bytes sha256>\n"

schedule.clock: clock_receive_time (each row's ts_recv_ns); a block closes at the first row whose running maximum (clock_event_known_by) reaches its end clock
schedule.rule: block 1 is 5 min, every later block 30 min (the last listed length repeats)

content.rule: the teacher's own account (its receipt account) for Frankie; the findings and the per-event differences are in the files named here

book_read.rule: beside the pinned functions on the same full rows (teacher_book_read); the rows before a resume whose save held no book read are read at publication from the same reader with the same functions

clock_lock_time.basis: the teacher's as_of (the latest receive clock of its rows), stamped once: not a picture element and never Frankie's lock
clock_lock_time.label: teacher_as_of (lock time does not exist before Frankie reads)

teacher_second_set.file_format: 64 hex digits of the sha256 of the bytes after them, then the pickle of the header with `records` (parallel_teacher._load_raw_state reads it)
teacher_second_set.key_rule: record i is teacher row i: key.adapter_cursor == the row cursor, its picture the one the walk read that row with (picture.original_applied is the row's payload)
teacher_second_set.plane_values: by reference: (source, source_ordinal) names the row of that stream's pinned file the picture handed over; the values are the ROOT's receipted rows, not copied

state_split.dipole: teacher.dstate|... : the teacher row's own DState (status, state.anchor_dir, state.armed, state.broken); derived_roll20_and_dipole_state is the teacher's Dipole state rows, not a picture plane
state_split.generic_rule: a lifecycle section not in label_fields: every top-level text or true/false field except ['member_id', 'runway_id', 'mirror_pair_key', 'level_event_key_at_exit', 'action_string', 'side_string', 'schema', 'clock', 'binning_clock', 'emitted_on', 'emitting_section']
state_split.per_row: each R3 short window (64 groups) on its side: every label field's buckets with the event and book parts, sums_back per field, pinned_check against the row's pinned columns
